description: This file defines flags and functions for handling template-based printing in Kubernetes CLI, including format validation, reading templates from files, and creating printers.

classes.name: GoTemplatePrintFlags
classes.description: Struct holding flags for template printing, including template argument and missing keys allowance.

methods.name: AllowedFormats
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of supported template formats.

methods.name: ToPrinter
methods.description: Creates a resource printer based on the specified template format and arguments.

methods.name: AddFlags
methods.description: Binds template-related flags to a Cobra command.

methods.name: NewGoTemplatePrintFlags
methods.description: Initializes a new GoTemplatePrintFlags instance with default values.
